note: Confirmed real (PDF reprint 'as at 1 May 2021' obtained manually). Agency-drafted NZTA Rule using a tilde-ID scheme, not year/number; no en/latest.xml endpoint, so it is excluded from the step11 fetch (no way to check what IT cites out to). The only known incoming edge into this Rule is from Immigration Act 2009 -- but Immigration Act 2009 is an SG1 Act, not SG2, so this is an SG1->SG2 edge, not an SG2-internal one, and it is already captured in sg2_final_list.json (linked_from) and already drawn by make_sg1_sg2_diagram.py. No manual SG2-internal edge is needed for this Act; step11 simply skips it as unfetchable, same as any other resolved-but-no-xml entry.
